info.name: Snapchat Ads Ad Accounts Measurement API

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the campaign

params.name: granularity
params.description: The time granularity for statistics. Determines how data points are grouped in the response.

params.name: start_time
params.description: The start time for the statistics query in ISO 8601 format.

params.name: end_time
params.description: The end time for the statistics query in ISO 8601 format.

items.docs: Retrieves performance statistics for a specific campaign, including impressions, spend, and conversion metrics.
